model: Orbital Economy v7.7.13 Labor Market candidate r1
note: Task 034 fragment. Covers every new labor_market parameter required by TASK_RU §2: the switch, all six declaration parameters, and all five asymmetric A/B pairs (annotation on A with applies_to_mirror).

Labor Market Enabled.role: Labor-market switch; default 0 and enabled only by new Modes 52–53.
Labor Market Enabled.effect: At 0 every labor_market replacement selects the previous branch; at 1 population-driven demand, flexible wages and labor-availability guards are active.

Metal Demand per Capita.effect: When the labor market is enabled, each region's Local Base Demand becomes this norm multiplied by its Population; it also replaces the old population-dependent target as a Planet P6 external driver.

Electronics Demand per Capita.effect: When enabled, each region's Electronics Local Base Demand becomes this norm multiplied by Population; it is the corresponding Planet P6 external driver.

Wage Adjustment Rate.role: Flexible-wage adjustment rate, 0.000277777777778 per model day (10% per 360-day model year).
Wage Adjustment Rate.effect: Scales Wage Increase/Decrease response to the gap between Labor Tightness and Target Labor Tightness.

Target Labor Tightness.role: Target ratio of smoothed labor demand to labor force, value 0.95.
Target Labor Tightness.effect: Defines the wage equilibrium target; tightness above it raises wages, below it lowers wages.

Wage Floor Share.role: Lower bound for flexible wage as a share of the region's Initial Wage, value 0.3.
Wage Floor Share.effect: Prevents Flexible Wage from falling below 30% of the pre-labor-market wage.

Labor Demand Signal Time.role: Smoothing time of unconstrained labor demand, 10 model days.
Labor Demand Signal Time.effect: Controls how quickly Labor Demand Signal follows labor demand reconstructed before the output guard.

A Initial Wage.role: Named copy of the pre-labor-market regional wage; A=100, B=140.
A Initial Wage.effect: Provides the exact switch-off branch and the wage-floor reference without embedding asymmetric numeric literals in mirrored A/B formulas.
A Initial Wage.evidence: V7_7_13_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §§0–2; generated by labor_market from the accepted A/B Wage values.

A Flexible Wage.role: Initial flexible-wage STOCK; A starts at 100, B at 140, equal to each region's previous Wage.
A Flexible Wage.effect: Becomes the active Wage branch when Labor Market Enabled=1 and evolves through Wage Increase/Decrease.
A Flexible Wage.evidence: V7_7_13_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §§1,5 and labor_market generator start-state rule.

A External Local Base Demand.role: Named copy of the former external metal-demand driver; A=16, B=22.
A External Local Base Demand.effect: Preserves the exact switch-off Local Base Demand while enabled demand is recomputed from Metal Demand per Capita × Population.
A External Local Base Demand.evidence: V7_7_13_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §§0–2,5; accepted v7.7.12 regional Local Base Demand constants.

A External Electronics Local Base Demand.role: Named copy of the former external electronics-demand driver; A=20, B=16.
A External Electronics Local Base Demand.effect: Preserves the exact switch-off Electronics Local Base Demand while enabled demand is recomputed from Electronics Demand per Capita × Population.
A External Electronics Local Base Demand.evidence: V7_7_13_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §§0–2; accepted v7.7.12 regional Electronics Local Base Demand constants.

A Labor Demand Signal.role: Initial smoothed unconstrained labor-demand STOCK; A=14, B=4.25 (= initial Population × Labor Participation Share 0.5).
A Labor Demand Signal.effect: Seeds the labor-availability guard without a startup discontinuity and is the denominator driver of Labor Availability/Tightness.
A Labor Demand Signal.evidence: V7_7_13_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §§1,5 and labor_market generator: Population Initial × Labor Participation Share.
